```yaml
name: Clean Unused L10n Strings

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'   # first day of every month at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-unused-strings:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Run detection script
        id: detect
        run: |
          python Tools/detect_unused_strings.py > unused_strings.txt
          echo "unused_count=$(wc -l < unused_strings.txt | tr -d ' ')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post or update PR comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const unused = fs.readFileSync('unused_strings.txt', 'utf8').trim();
            const count = unused.split('\n').filter(Boolean).length;
            const body = `### ⚠️ Unused L10n strings detected\n\nFound **${count}** unused strings:\n\n${unused}`;
            const { data: comments } = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number
            });
            const existing = comments.find(c => c.body.startsWith('### ⚠️ Unused L10n strings detected'));
            if (existing) {
              await github.rest.issues.updateComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                comment_id: existing.id,
                body
              });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: context.issue.number,
                body
              });
            }

  clean-unused-strings:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Run detection script
        run: python Tools/detect_unused_strings.py > unused_strings.txt

      - name: Run removal script
        run: python Tools/remove_unused_strings.py

      - name: Check for changes
        id: changes
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "no_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "no_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.changes.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: cleanup-unused-strings-${{ github.run_id }}
          title: "chore: remove unused L10n strings"
          body: |
            This PR removes unused L10n strings detected by the automated workflow.
          commit-message: "chore: remove unused L10n strings"
          delete-branch: true
          base: main
          labels: "automation, l10n"
```
